subject: Investor update: consolidated deck + OKR alignment
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: board@redwoodinvestors.com
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Investor update: consolidated deck + OKR alignment

Team — attaching a consolidated investor deck draft and the OKR tracker for the quarter. Objective here is to: 1) lock the narrative arc for the board packet, 2) confirm the OKR posture slide (metrics + color), and 3) decide on two optional appendix slides (capacity economics + canary rollout plan).

Ask: please review the attached slides and the tracker by EOD Friday PDT and leave comments in the Drive doc. I’d like a one-paragraph narrative for the Operational Highlights slide from each of you by Friday so I can synthesize.

Attachments:
- 2027-04-01_Redwood_Investor_Update_v0.7.pptx (deck draft)
- OKR-tracker-Apr2027.csv

Thanks — r

--
Rachel Kim
Head of Finance Programs (acting)
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

---------------------------------------------------------------------

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Investor update: consolidated deck + OKR alignment

Rachel — thanks for sending. Quick pass below; I’ll add slide-level comments in the deck too.

High-level:
- Love the narrative progression (market -> product -> ops -> ask). Recommend moving the "Unit Cost per 1K tokens" chart into appendix and replacing with a top-line "Cost per call" for the ops slide — board cares about product economics at a glance.
- Suggest we add a one-slide callout for Dedicated customer wins (two bullets) — shows stickiness.
- On the OKR slide: mark SLO attainment for inference latency as amber (we’re at 92% vs 99% target) and include a short mitigation note (autoscale policy change).

Minor:
- Slide 8: typo in caption ("throughput" -> "throughput/consumption")
- Can we compress the roadmap to two future milestones for clarity?

I’ll draft my Operational Highlights paragraph tonight.

—D

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Investor update: consolidated deck + OKR alignment

Adding a few items I think are important for the board audience:

- OKR slide: break out Product vs. Serving infra: investors need to see model-quality progress (eval pass rate) distinct from runtime KPIs. I can provide a short blurb on eval improvements and a micro-chart.
- Risk slide: please make the "dependence on third-party quantization tool" callout less technical — phrase as "external tooling maturity" and include mitigation (we’ve validated two alternatives).
- Appendix: include a single-pane "migration checklist" for Private customers (networking + KMS) — this has come up in renewals conversations.

Also attaching a CSV snippet I pulled from the OKR tracker with the playbook mapping. I left a couple inline comments in the deck.

Marissa
Sr. Dir, Product Ops

Thanks both — excellent notes. Quick updates:
- Moved cost chart to appendix and replaced the ops slide with "Cost per call" (Dylan’s suggestion).
- Marissa: adding separate small eval-quality micro-chart and a non-technical risk mitigation line.
- I’ll draft the Dedicated customer two-bullet callout using anonymized names (to keep NDA-safe).

Can everyone confirm: final comments in Drive by noon Monday PDT? I’ll do a slide freeze at 2pm and route the packet to executive review at 3pm for signoff before the board packet goes live.

Rachel
